# nososim

Simulate hospital outbreaks with changing patient populations, contact
patterns, and interventions.

Create a daily population, simulate transmission, and visualise who
infected whom.

## Installation

Install the development version from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("CyGei/nososim")
```

## A first outbreak

Simulate an outbreak in a population of 30 people, starting with one
infection. Containment strategy starts on day 10 reducing transmission
hazards by 50%.

``` r

library(nososim)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(123)
dates <- as.Date("2026-01-01") + 0:20

timeline <- make_timeline(n = 30, dates = dates, admission_delay = 0:4, R = 2)
initial <- data.frame(id = "ID_1", date_infection = dates[1])

outbreak <- make_outbreak(
  timeline,
  initial,
  w = dpois(0:10, 2),
  dates = dates,
  intervention = function(present, date) {
    E_t <- matrix(
      0,
      nrow(present),
      nrow(present),
      dimnames = list(present$id, present$id)
    )
    if (date >= dates[10]) {
      E_t[,] <- 0.5
    }
    E_t
  }
)

autoplot(outbreak, aes(colour = I("#B8D8D3"), fill = I("#176B65")))
```

![](reference/figures/README-first-outbreak-1.png)

## Go further

The [getting started
guide](https://CyGei.github.io/nososim/articles/nososim.html) walks
through ward transfers, staff schedules, mixing patterns, and masking.
Browse the [function
reference](https://CyGei.github.io/nososim/reference/index.html) for
individual function arguments and examples.

# Package index

## Create a population

- [`make_timeline()`](https://cygei.github.io/nososim/reference/make_timeline.md)
  : Generate a daily population timeline
- [`set_attribute()`](https://cygei.github.io/nososim/reference/set_attribute.md)
  : Update individual attributes
- [`set_schedule()`](https://cygei.github.io/nososim/reference/set_schedule.md)
  : Set individual weekly schedules

## Simulate transmission

- [`make_outbreak()`](https://cygei.github.io/nososim/reference/make_outbreak.md)
  : Simulate an outbreak

## Explore results

- [`autoplot(`*`<nososim_timeline>`*`)`](https://cygei.github.io/nososim/reference/autoplot.nososim_timeline.md)
  [`autoplot(`*`<nososim_outbreak>`*`)`](https://cygei.github.io/nososim/reference/autoplot.nososim_timeline.md)
  : Plot a population timeline or outbreak
- [`summary(`*`<nososim_outbreak>`*`)`](https://cygei.github.io/nososim/reference/summary.nososim_outbreak.md)
  : Summarise an outbreak
- [`summary(`*`<nososim_timeline>`*`)`](https://cygei.github.io/nososim/reference/summary.nososim_timeline.md)
  : Summarise a population timeline

## Package

- [`nososim`](https://cygei.github.io/nososim/reference/nososim-package.md)
  [`nososim-package`](https://cygei.github.io/nososim/reference/nososim-package.md)
  : nososim: Nosocomial Outbreak Simulation
- [`reexports`](https://cygei.github.io/nososim/reference/reexports.md)
  [`autoplot`](https://cygei.github.io/nososim/reference/reexports.md) :
  Objects exported from other packages
